description: Debounce delay set to 0 AND the stale-response guard removed: a request fires per keystroke and results flicker as out-of-order responses land. In the critical stale-response-ignored test the slow "an" response (700ms) overwrites the fast "ann" result (100ms), leaving 7 rows instead of 2. Also drops the loading flag after the stale response. Empty-state and clear-input tests still pass.
